notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Witches!

A lot has happened since the last update in February.
We released a new demo update with a new map, additional cards, and a new game mode. 
Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3]Frozen Lake[/h3][p]A new map has been added. Frozen Lake leans toward the larger end of what we’re aiming for in terms of map size and offers a more distinct visual style.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/9d3dc9b0c8a66c3e615e7bcd23315b9f8d81c6c5.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3]Suit Of Pentacles[/h3][p]The Pentacle suit is now available and expands your deck with support-oriented options and long-term scaling effects.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c8daf8ca67e22fff4430b07e54eaeb03501cd92d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]The Chariot & Mage Rework[/h3][p]The Chariot has been added, a powerful movement card that brings a witch's most important tool into play: The Broom. 
We've also reworked the Magician card: Now each suit features its own Mage, summoning skeletons that follow Clovelin and cast passive attacks tied to their element. The first two, Wands and Cups, are already in the demo, Swords and Pentacles are still in testing[/p][p][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/a0fd699b5875f10b50794d41720c9322c06ed8b1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Survival Mode[/h3][p]The demo now includes a new mode focused on time based progression. This benefits a more aggressive playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c9c2898685936cd64f681c90193fdde8c9341abe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]QoL Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Tooltips for cards during combat[/p][/*][*][p]Automatic wave-start zoom[/p][/*][*][p]Basic resolution and audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Visual and performance updates[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Stay tuned as we'll soon add a variety of new enemies![/b][/p][p]
See you in Hell![/p][p][/p][p]Dayshift[/p]

notes.title: What's to come
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, and welcome to all the new Witches!

There’s been a lot going on with Witchhammer! Here's a quick update on the things we've been working on:

[h3]New Cards[/h3]
The Suit of Cups and ten additional Major Arcanas are now fully integrated, expanding the card pool from 37 to 60 cards.

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Plague Doctor: Buffs and heals allies, making fights last longer.
[*] The Elite Hunter: Fires a barrage of arrows (Imagine Legolas with a AK-47).
[/list]

[h3]Quality of life Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tooltips: Hover over cards for instant in-fight effect descriptions.
[*] Camera Zoom: Auto-zooms at the start of each wave for better visibility.
[*] Audio & Resolution Settings: Customization options for basic optimization.
[*] Optimizations & VFX: Improved models, effects, and performance for fluid gameplay.
[/list]

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]

[h3]Suit of Pentacles[/h3]
The final suit consisting of 14 cards is nearly ready for open testing. Pentacle cards will boost other suits and enhance Tarot Readings, offering more control over your deck development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c8daf8ca67e22fff4430b07e54eaeb03501cd92d.png[/img]

[h3]Survival Mode[/h3]
A new gamemode where Tarot Readings appear based on enemies defeated, allowing you to control how fast your deck evolves and rewarding more aggressive gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/63039995ecca42ea6a13acada724af978ea14b77.png[/img]

[h3]Glossary[/h3]
We’re working on a Glossary system to review all unlocked and locked cards, to track skills and check your overall progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c0755f776d003dc0be4b7c6f1e3a8ad9718f5e78.png[/img]

[h3]Maps & Visuals[/h3]
We’re testing new layouts and adding foliage for more variety

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/c1a2b82f8dd3f6aad016345093b57b0c843e2808.png[/img]

[h3]The Village[/h3]
Our hub is deep in testing. Here, you’ll trade Bones for upgrades, prepare for battle, and maybe even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/41390b9af97a6a71f7e66b1bbde39eb2dd6ffdc2.gif[/img]

[h3]The Inquisitor[/h3]
His time will come. He's still in the works, but he’ll be a fight to remember.


We’ll be testing some of these additions soon, so stay tuned for Demo Updates!
Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Hell!

Dayshift

notes.title: What's to come
notes.notes:
Hey Witches!

If you enjoyed our demo, there is a lot more content for you to look forward to! Here are the things we are working on or testing right now.

[h3]New Cards[/h3] 
With the Suit of Cups we introduce the third starter deck and add 13 new cards focused around lightning, strorms and the power of regeneration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/b4d0d9a4abe03d873b052a930fedfe300324bfbe.png[/img]

[h3]The Village[/h3] 
You will discover a nearby village whose inhabitants are willing to aid you. Here you can spend your collected souls in exchange for even greater power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/41390b9af97a6a71f7e66b1bbde39eb2dd6ffdc2.gif[/img]

[h3]VFX Rework[/h3] 
We're enhancing visual effects, optimizing particle systems, and refining card and enemy effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/64502241a1c9a174b1829c9762deeeb260cfa07e.gif[/img]

[h3]The Inquisitor[/h3] Prepare to face off against our most evil and most dangerous foe, the Inquisitor. He will be the final test of your skills and strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752145/5180fdfe61772657f9e3da5fc663130c73832cad.png[/img]

In addition, a brand new map and even more new cards are joining the fray, but let's not spoil it all.

Thank you all very much for playing our game and bring your feedback and suggestions so we can keep firing our forges. See you in Hell!

Dayshift
